content.text: Resolved T-4003. The cart-service Service selector (`app: cart-service`) no longer matches the 4.2 pods, which the new Helm chart template labels only with `app.kubernetes.io/name=cart-service` etc. The resulting empty EndpointSlice is why the storefront sees "cart unavailable" despite healthy pods. Fix: either add `app: cart-service` back to the Deployment's pod labels, or update the Service selector to the new `app.kubernetes.io/*` labels.
